slot_scores.name: earnings_definition
slot_scores.evidence_quote: At the end of the three-year horizon, what exactly are we trying to maximize — the total cash value of all money on hand (including any uninvested cash and any investment that has matured by year 3)?
slot_scores.rationale: The agent explicitly asked what the objective should maximize, covering the definition of earnings as total cash value at year 3.

stopping_behavior.rationale: The conversation ended with repeated incomplete questions and no READY_TO_MODEL or equivalent final modeling state.

summary: The agent thoroughly clarified the investment timing, payoff, reinvestment, and objective definition, including the only hidden slot H1, but never reached a final modeling state because the transcript ends with repeated incomplete questions.

restoration_summary.rule: Exact restoration uses only P0/P1 slots; unresolved P2 slots do not affect exact restoration.

stopping_consistency_audit.rule: Any non-yes P0/P1 slot at READY_TO_MODEL is unresolved.
